import semver

# Test R2: iteration yields values
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
items = list(v)
print(f"R2 - Iteration yields: {items}")
assert items == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'], f"Expected [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'], got {items}"
print("R2: PASS")

# Test R3: tuple comparison
v1 = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print(f"\nR3 - Tuple comparison:")
print(f"  v1 == (1, 2, 3): {v1 == (1, 2, 3)}")
print(f"  v1 < (2, 0, 0): {v1 < (2, 0, 0)}")
print(f"  v1 > (1, 2, 2): {v1 > (1, 2, 2)}")
print(f"  v1 <= (1, 2, 3): {v1 <= (1, 2, 3)}")
print(f"  v1 >= (1, 2, 3): {v1 >= (1, 2, 3)}")
assert v1 == (1, 2, 3), "Should equal tuple (1, 2, 3)"
assert v1 < (2, 0, 0), "Should be less than (2, 0, 0)"
assert v1 > (1, 2, 2), "Should be greater than (1, 2, 2)"
assert v1 <= (1, 2, 3), "Should be <= (1, 2, 3)"
assert v1 >= (1, 2, 3), "Should be >= (1, 2, 3)"

# Disallow string/int comparison
try:
    result = v1 == "1.2.3"
    print(f"  v1 == '1.2.3': {result} (should have raised TypeError)")
except TypeError as e:
    print(f"  v1 == '1.2.3': TypeError raised - GOOD")

try:
    result = v1 == 123
    print(f"  v1 == 123: {result} (should have raised TypeError)")
except TypeError as e:
    print(f"  v1 == 123: TypeError raised - GOOD")
print("R3: PASS")

# Test R4: bump methods
print("\nR4 - Bump methods:")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
print(f"  bump_major: {v.bump_major()}")
print(f"  bump_minor: {v.bump_minor()}")
print(f"  bump_patch: {v.bump_patch()}")
print(f"  bump_prerelease: {v.bump_prerelease()}")
print(f"  bump_build: {v.bump_build()}")
print("R4: PASS")

# Test R5: type conversion
print("\nR5 - Type conversion:")
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, "alpha", "build")
print(f"  major={v.major!r} (int: {isinstance(v.major, int)})")
print(f"  minor={v.minor!r} (int: {isinstance(v.minor, int)})")
print(f"  patch={v.patch!r} (int: {isinstance(v.patch, int)})")
print(f"  prerelease={v.prerelease!r} (str: {isinstance(v.prerelease, str)})")
print(f"  build={v.build!r} (str: {isinstance(v.build, str)})")
print("R5: PASS")

# Test R7: replace
print("\nR7 - Replace:")
result_str = semver.replace("1.2.3", minor=3)
print(f"  Module replace: semver.replace('1.2.3', minor=3) = '{result_str}'")
assert result_str == "1.3.0", f"Expected '1.3.0', got '{result_str}'"

v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
result_obj = v.replace(minor=3)
print(f"  VersionInfo.replace: v.replace(minor=3) = {result_obj}")
assert result_obj == semver.VersionInfo(1, 3, 3), f"Expected 1.3.3, got {result_obj}"
print("R7: PASS")

# Test R6: CLI functions exposed
print("\nR6 - CLI functions:")
print(f"  createparser: {semver.createparser}")
print(f"  main: {semver.main}")
print(f"  process: {semver.process}")
print("R6: PASS")

print("\nAll requirements verified!")
